requirement.description: {data_dave} proposed automating the hand off from hyperparameter tuning to the training pipeline. He wants the hand off to fire automatically so training starts without delay.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} proposed automating the hand off from hyperparameter tuning to the training pipeline.
requirement.reading: He wants the hand off to fire automatically so training starts without delay.

author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I have been watching the gap between when hyperparameter tuning finishes and when the training pipeline actually starts. Right now that hand off is done by hand, and the delay is eating into our nightly window. I want that step to fire automatically so the next training run kicks off the moment the tuning job closes. Every minute we save there is a minute we can use for more iterations or a cleaner data validation pass. The more we automate that transition, the faster the whole loop turns, and the better the models get in the long run. There is no downside to removing the manual trigger, only upside in speed and consistency.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that the more the transition is automated, the faster the loop turns and the better the models get, indicating that exceeding the basic request for automation would increase their satisfaction.
